services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Easily reached by public transportation or car, Brooklyn Botanic Garden provides stunning settings and tranquil spaces for your private and corporate events. Culinary partner Union Square Events, one of the most highly acclaimed caterers in the region, brings exceptional cuisine and impeccable service. Whether you're planning a corporate retreat or a holiday party, Union Square Events’ experienced team of chefs and event managers will work with you to make your event a success. When you host an event at BBG, you get more than just a venue. You'll be supporting the Garden's mission to connect people to the world of plants and environmental stewardship.
